Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤯. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his expression firm but concerned 😬.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 🤝.

JACK:
(suddenly alert)
No! I won't take it! It's poison! 🚽

DR. SMITH:
(calmly)
Jack, you're not thinking clearly. You need to take your medication to manage your symptoms 💊.

JACK:
(defiantly)
I won't do it! You can't make me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(firmly)
I'm ordering you to take your medication, Jack. Now 🚪.

Jack refuses, and Dr. Smith is forced to take the medication himself 💊. He downs the pills in one swift motion, and suddenly, the room begins to distort and blur 🌌.

DR. SMITH:
(confused)
What's happening? 🤔

As he looks around, he realizes that Jack is no longer in the room 🚫. Instead, he sees a figure standing in front of him - a figure that looks exactly like himself 👻.

JACK (V.O.):
You're the one who's been pretending to be sane all along, Doctor. You're the one who's been trapped in your own delusions 🤯.

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth: he's been the one with the schizophrenia all along 🤯. The medication, the hospital, the entire world - it's all been a product of his own fractured mind 🌪️.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering)
Oh no... I've been living in a dream world... 🌙

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's world continues to distort and blur, and the sound of his own screams echo through the empty room 🎧.

FADE TO BLACK 🌑
